caller_responsibilities: Freeze and verify source/text/truth/review byte SHA and exact bindings before supplying Parent values.
Freeze semantic supervision eligibility, complete original membership, roles and whole-group identities externally.
Bind final roleplan source and the enum bridge at public integration; current observed enum alone does not freeze membership.
Keep full-candidate runtime evaluation, original truth, acceptable sets, fallback and evaluation support scope separately.

invariants.features: same hintlearn.Features on original request and candidate text only
invariants.known_labels: all acceptable indices one; all other candidates zero
invariants.masked_known: same original label and physical row; explicit weight zero
invariants.unknown: nullable audit only; no fit row; full runtime retained
invariants.calibration: full audit retained; no fit or training diagnostic row
invariants.weights: unit one or mask zero; no new balancing/objective
invariants.AUC: positive-weight-only copied view plus denominators; existing AUC unchanged and unweighted
invariants.ownership: fixed Prepared/acceptable arrays and independent fit/AUC slices; immutable Go string bytes shared
invariants.group_check: cross-role leakage detected only within the supplied batch, including unknown/masked/calibration

includes: both fit and both diagnostic dataset arrays
